title: Learning-Augmented Online Minimization with Dual Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2606.05380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present learning-augmented algorithms for two general classes of online minimization problems: metrical task systems and laminar set cover. Both algorithms achieve improved theoretical guarantees using machine-learned predictions of an optimal solution to the dual linear program. Unlike optimal primal solutions, which can change drastically under tiny instance perturbations, these dual solutions are much more stable, which ensures the existence of good (and learnable) predictions for families of similar instances. While previous work has used dual predictions in offline settings and for online maximization problems, our algorithms are, to the best of our knowledge, the first demonstration that such dual predictions can be effective for online minimization. Our theoretical results are complemented by experiments on the $k$-server problem and the parking permit problem.

translated_title: 基于对偶预测的学习增强在线最小化
translated_abstract: 我们为两类通用的在线最小化问题提出了学习增强算法：度量任务系统和层析集合覆盖。这两种算法都通过使用机器学习对对偶线性规划最优解的预测，实现了改进的理论保证。与最优原始解在实例受到微小扰动时可能发生剧烈变化不同，这些对偶解要稳定得多，这确保了对于相似实例族存在良好（且可学习）的预测。尽管先前的工作已在离线场景和在线最大化问题中使用了对偶预测，但据我们所知，我们的算法首次证明了对偶预测能够有效应用于在线最小化问题。我们的理论结果还通过k服务器问题和停车许可问题的实验得到了补充验证。
tldr: 本文首次将对偶线性规划最优解的机器学习预测有效应用于在线最小化问题，利用对偶解相比原始解的稳定性，在度量任务系统和层析集合覆盖问题上获得了改进的理论保证，并通过k服务器和停车许可问题的实验加以验证。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first learning-augmented algorithms for online minimization that leverage machine-learned predictions of dual LP solutions—whose stability ensures learnable predictions—to achieve improved guarantees for metrical task systems and laminar set cover, validated experimentally on the k-server and parking permit problems.
